highlights: Drag Frame and cutting start points on the canvas and save reusable defaults. Saved projects retain their chosen starts; Frame still verifies the exact reviewed job before Start.
Power and Speed now pair sliders with exact number entry and one-step undo. Refreshed artwork panels, machine tool tabs and compact Origin controls make settings easier to reach.
Trace-part and node editing respond more quickly on dense artwork, with clearer Done controls. Preview status updates keep the canvas layout steady.
New layout and selection tools change draw order, match sizes, close gaps and select circles or open Fill shapes. Bake variable text, export original or preview images, and share image presets.
More text styles, barcode formats, font favourites and array options expand design choices. Saved artwork can be renamed, recategorised or replaced while keeping its library entry.
Expanded precision editing, material workflows and portable printing accompany faster path indexing. Generated cut paths use the prepared output, including variable text and cutting adjustments.
